europe_now.title: Russia-Ukraine Overnight Strikes
europe_now.summary: Russia and Ukraine exchanged deadly overnight strikes, with casualties reported on both sides. The attacks were confirmed by the World Health Organization, which noted a warehouse destroyed in the strikes.

europe_now.title: Spain-Italy Border Dispute
